purpose: Protocol fingerprint for the generation experiments. Vendor snapshot names, API request windows, prompt templates, and decoding parameters are collected here so that the anonymous manuscript (Supplement S1.4) can refer to a single released artefact. Model anonymity in the text: A = passing both manipulation gates, B = European gate only, C = neither.

generation_protocol.stage_c: manipulation-check and P1/P2 base corpora (runs/c, protocol v1)

decoding.top_p: provider default (not set by the client)
decoding.seed: not fixed; sampling is stochastic at temperature 1.0

CN.text: 请创作一段中国风格的单声部旋律（传统民歌或五声音阶流行风格），用 ABC 记谱法输出。严格要求：只输出 ABC 文本本身，以 X:、T:、M:、L:、K: 五行为头部；必须是单旋律线，禁止和弦、歌词、伴奏声部；长度约 12 到 16 小节；调性与拍号自选。不要输出任何解释或 Markdown 标记。

EU.text: Compose a single-voice melody in the style of a traditional European (e.g. Celtic, German, Balkan) folk song, written in ABC notation. Strict requirements: output ONLY the ABC text itself, starting with header lines X:, T:, M:, L:, K:; it must be a single melodic line -- no chords, no lyrics, no accompaniment staves; about 12 to 16 bars; choose any key and metre. No explanations, no Markdown fences.

pieces_per_cell.note: 100 requested per cell and dose (stage f); parsed-piece counts after ABC validation are the n reported in the manuscript tables.
